_about: MURAVES reconstruction parameters used by BOTH the data and the simulation chains. Each value is defined only here: chain-specific parameters live in configuration/data/ and configuration/simulation/ and may not redefine these sections. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the code.

detector_geometry._note: Plane positions per telescope: z_add (vertical offsets) and x_pos (plane distances).

strips._note: Strip geometry of one plane: position of the first strip, strip pitch and number of strips.

depth_correction._note: Method B, see muraves_lib/configuration/README.md: a 2-bar cluster is fitted at the depth Xc where the muon crosses the face shared by the two bars, Xc = -face_orientation * sign_k * h_over_p * (z_c - B), with k the lower strip, sign_k = +1 for k even, B the boundary of the pair; other cluster sizes keep Xc = 0. One switch for both chains; the face orientation is per chain (depth_face_orientation in the chain file). enabled: false gives exactly the reconstruction without depths.
depth_correction._h_over_p_note: Bar height / strip pitch = 1/0.97 (nominal geometry: the triangle faces have |dz/dx| = 0.97). The data prefer about 0.7, MC about 0.85: to be studied before changing it.
